task: Remove all user TMS tokens on explicit CodeMie logout (EPMCDME-15392) across both logout routes, failing safely on deletion errors without leaking token values, preserving existing logout behavior, with tests.

key_reasoning.reason: Two logout routers (local_auth_router POST, user.py GET Keycloak redirect) plus a new shared logout-cleanup unit and the enterprise-bridge TMS handle (enterprise/mcp_auth/dependencies.py); shared security utilities (tms_vault_ops.delete_all_for_user, TMSTokenStore, TokenExchangeService.clear_cache) are in play. 3-4 components across API, Service and bridge. Mechanism reuses existing user-wide delete primitives, so not XL.

ACs are enumerated but AC4 ('handled safely, no stale token silently reused') is vague and leaves design decisions open: fail-closed vs complete-logout-with-error, sync delete vs the existing queued best-effort cleanup, and how to resolve the user id on the unauthenticated GET /v1/user/log_out route. Rework risk if the wrong semantics are chosen.

Security-sensitive authentication/session change. Closest pattern is USER_OFFBOARDING cleanup (enqueue_mcp_auth_cleanup -> MCPAuthService worker) and TMSTokenStore.invalidate_all_for_user; both are best-effort or swallow TMS errors, the opposite of AC4, so the pattern does not cover the fail-safe/security aspect. Keycloak route has no authenticate dependency and no tests. Per-process TTL caches (TokenExchangeService, TMSTokenStore fallback) are unreachable from other pods and per-user state outside TMS (MCPToolkitFactory cache, mcp-connect client cache) is unexamined. Token values must not leak via TokenProviderException details or logs. Rollback itself is trivial (revert), which keeps this below XXL.

Est. 4 modified (local_auth_router.py, user.py, a bridge or TMS helper such as dependencies.py/tms_token_store.py, test_local_auth_router.py) and 3 new (logout-cleanup service module, its test, test for GET log_out) across 3+ directories (rest_api/routers, service/security or enterprise/mcp_auth, tests/*). No codemie-ui or codemie-enterprise change evidenced.
